test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following in a logical and meaningful order.

I. Superintendent of Police

II. Station House Officer

III. Inspector General

IV. Deputy Superintendent of Police
solution:
The logic followed here is:

These all are the names of the post of police officers** **and we can arrange them in ascending order or descending order of their ranks.

**1.** Ascending order of their ranks is as follows:

**Station House Officer → **Deputy Superintendent of Police → Superintendent of Police → Inspector General 

**2. **Descending order of their ranks as follows:

 Inspector General → Superintendent of Police → Deputy Superintendent of Police → Station House Officer

Thus, the arrangement of these posts in a logical and meaningful order is as follows:

**II, IV, I, III (Ascending order)**

Hence, **"II, IV, I, III"**** **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 Inspector General 
 A senior police officer in the police force
 
 

 Superintendent of Police
 Head of the police force of a district
 
 

 Deputy Superintendent of Police 
 They are state police officers who belong to the provincial police forces.
 
 

 Station House Officer
 He is the head in charge of the locality police station
